implementationScope: Reusable 2026 FPLD contribution primitive for OTD/OTI agricultural workers employed by the generality of agricultural employers, bounded at or below the source-reported additional-1% threshold.

normalizedFacts.employerFpldRateDerivation: 30.50 - 8.84; exact arithmetic derivation, not a verbatim percentage in Circular 43/2026

calculationSemantics: The caller supplies an already determined FPLD contribution base.
Total contribution is rounded from the 30.50% total rate; worker contribution is rounded from 8.84%; employer contribution is the cent-exact remainder so the breakdown reconciles to the total.
The primitive does not construct a contribution base from salary, days, collective-contract minima or payroll-period rules.
The €122,295 figure remains reference-only because this v1 fails closed before the additional-1% path at €56,224.
failClosedBoundaries: more than two decimal places or non-finite/negative monetary inputs
